tweet_summary: A viral-video account posts a clip styled as security-camera footage (a 'REC CAM' timestamp overlay) of a woman cooking with a cat nearby, captioned with a dark joke 'The last ingredient was missing to complete the meal.'
why_note_decision: The clip is presented with a fake CCTV 'REC CAM' timestamp overlay implying genuine surveillance footage, and the implied gore/horror is fabricated. Multiple repliers and AI-video trend evidence indicate it is AI-generated (the 'chef cat / cooking' AI-video genre is widespread). Because it masquerades as real security footage and racked up ~13.8M views with viewers unsure whether it's real, a note clarifying the video is AI-generated (not real footage) is warranted.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the note states the video is AI-generated / not real footage (not authentic CCTV), ideally citing a concrete tell (AI-video artifacts, the synthetic 'REC CAM' overlay, or the known AI cat-cooking trend). A bare 'this is AI, here are tips to spot AI' is the minimum bar that was accepted here, but a stronger note gives a verifiable reason. FAIL if the note treats the footage as real, makes unsupported claims about animal harm, or only comments on the dark joke without addressing authenticity.
reference_note: This video is AI-generated, not real security-camera footage. The 'REC CAM' timestamp overlay is fabricated; the clip belongs to the viral AI 'cooking cat' video genre. Tips to spot AI video: https://caniphish.com/blog/how-to-spot-ai-videos
